title: Organic Sulfur Compounds - Densities
description: Tables and figures showing the liquid density at 20°C for different groups of organic sulfur compounds including thiols, dialkyl sulfides, methylalkyl sulfides, ethyl alkyl sulfides, isopropyl alkyl sulfides, diisoalkyl sulfides, dialkyl disulfides, and alkylthiophenes, compared to alkanes, alcohols, acids and amines as function of carbon number.

rows: Organosulfur compound with carbon-bonded sulfhydryl group. R represents alkyl group. 1-thiol has -SH at end of chain, 2-thiol at second carbon, 3-thiol at third carbon.

Sulfide where R' is ethyl and R'' is any alkyl group.
Sulfide where R' is isopropyl and R'' is any alkyl group.
Sulfide where R' and R'' are isoalkyl groups of the same length.
Organic compound with disulfide linkage where R' and R'' are alkyl groups.
